decisions.reason: Its disappearance from observed website references after 2019 suggests results likely stayed below aspiration for a niche hardware variant, and despite some slack a large growing firm would reallocate those resources to stronger core and digital traceability projects.
As a successor app close to the established offer and well aligned with the firm's move toward digitalization and traceability, it is likely to be retained unless its uptake clearly disappoints.
An inline code verification system fits core customer needs in compliance and end-to-end traceability, so a growing innovative firm would usually continue it while learning about demand.

Print layout design software supports the installed base and common operation across systems, so organizational slack and strategic fit favor keeping it even if standalone performance is still somewhat uncertain.
